notes: Leafkin Druid (M20): '{T}: Add {G}. If you control four or more creatures, add {G}{G} instead.' The Druid and three other creatures you control are four, so its tap makes {G}{G} and alone pays Canopy Spider's {1}{G} exactly. Mana abilities are no menu rows (2026-11-11): a game activates one only while a cost is paid, the payer choosing the source and its colour (CR 605.3a), so the pack pays through a cast with "tap": true or the menu (act). The payer prices the branch the state picks (E2, 2026-11-17); with {G} only the Spider could not be cast.
